recommendations.body: `plan_tool/create.py:_parse_risk_profile_json()` (step 2 "Classify seed-fed single-plan paths and default no-source create to standard") uses `json.loads()` without duplicate-key detection, so `{"tier":"standard","tier":"low",...}` is accepted as `low` instead of failing closed as an ambiguous response
recommendations.suggested_action: reject duplicate keys at every JSON-object level before validating the closed classifier shape in `plan_tool/create.py:_parse_risk_profile_json()` and add duplicate-key regressions in `tests/test_create.py:TestRiskProfileClassification`

recommendations.body: `plan_tool/create.py:_risk_profile_source_counter_signals()` (step 2 "Classify seed-fed single-plan paths and default no-source create to standard") applies negative-evidence regexes to an entire clause, so `No new contract is created and the existing contract changes.` produces no signal and permits a valid-looking `low` proposal despite the required positive contract counter-signal; the same masking class affects consumer, migration, auth/authz, and surface checks
recommendations.suggested_action: scope negative evidence to each counter-signal mention in `plan_tool/create.py:_risk_profile_source_counter_signals()` and add mixed negative-plus-positive regressions for every counter-signal class in `tests/test_create.py:TestRiskProfileClassification`
